item: Confirm the walkthrough date and time with the client
Send the site protection and access plan to the client
Confirm the crew list and which trades attend the walkthrough
Print the approved scope and the selections sheet for the walkthrough
Check that the signed contract and the returned intake questionnaire are both on file
Walk the work area with the client and agree the boundary of the site
Photograph every room in scope before any work starts
Set out the dust barriers, the floor protection and the crew entry route
Confirm the site access hours, the key handover and where the crew parks
Introduce the day to day point of contact by role and agree how questions get raised
Circulate the walkthrough notes and the agreed site boundary to the client
File the condition photographs in the project folder
Confirm the material delivery window and where deliveries are stored on site
Add the agreed selection dates to the project schedule
